review_evidence: The 1,719-file manifest was inspected by scope and sampled across the bucket; entries include Evm64 accelerator coverage/dispatch/types, opcode Program/Spec pairs, composition specifications, stack-execution bridges, and supporting semantics.

Representative manifest entries such as Add/LimbSpec, Add/Program, Add/Spec, AddMod composition specs, and AccountAccessorSpec are primary formalization content, not repository-maintenance scaffolding.
No content-level class in this bucket established a lossless hard exclusion; path roles therefore remain retained under the conservative review policy.
